name: Donation Alerts
description: A tip lands on your stream as an alert: who sent it and how much, written the way you write money, with a sound, a spoken line and a message in chat. Installs the alert and a small stage overlay it fires on, and connects the donation service you pick: Streamlabs, Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee, Fourthwall or Throne. You authorize the service and put the stage in OBS.
changelog: Initial release. The first product with an ingredient: one question, which donation service, answered at install and written into the integration, the alert trigger and the stage's tags.
ready_message: The alert is wired and waiting. Put the stage in OBS, send yourself a test tip, and watch it land.
notes: A test tip from your donation service's own dashboard travels the whole way, so it proves more than anything Overlabels could fake. Press it once; pressing it again needs test mode on, on the service's settings page.
The alert fires on the Donation stage only. The alert's Targeting tab lets it fire on other overlays of yours too.
The stage shows how many tips have arrived through the service and who sent the latest one. Both are controls on the service's settings page, so you can set them by hand.

ingredients.question: Where do your donations come in?
